Brief

Content must clearly convey the message of social media addiction, sourced from AJ’s Mindful Podcast video. Supporting footage (movies, YouTube and similar) is allowed.

Any creators residing in the US, we encourage you to fill out the form linked below so you also qualify.

Any account niche is welcome. If you can reach people who struggle with social media addiction, you can clip.

Your captions must use the hashtag: #SocialMediaJustice
